changelog: Full In-Game 3D MLO Studio client architecture with 3D grid snapping, altitude levels, and Top-Down view.
Interactive shell builder for floors, thick/thin walls, doors, windows, and multi-level staircases with Undo/Redo.
Material Workbench with 100+ textures, face/box selection, in-game eyedropper, and quick-fill.
Automated room flood-fill detection, 3D portal visualization with normal arrows, and 1-click issue auto-fixes.
Prop dresser with 3D translation/rotation gizmo and room-aware culling tags.
Instant zero-restart live walkthrough testing mode.
Universal CodeWalker MLO exporter generating standards-compliant .ytyp.xml, .ymap.xml, and _manifest.ymf.
Classified catalog of 1,500+ standard GTA V interior and architectural props across 9 categories.
Persistent project saving and loading with automatic MySQL schema (acn_mlo_projects) and disk backups.
